what: On hover the button bounces rubber-like up to 1.15x then settles at 1.1x (1s), and on release it snaps down to .97x then wobbles back to 1 (.7s). Pressing gives the same wobble in .7s. The ring type (round arrow button) bounces to 1.26x and settles at 1.2x, and on press it collapses to .88 then rebounds to 1.15 (.4s).

options.scale: Hold scale, default 1.1 (ring 1.2) — in css it is --fx-scale
options.dur: Duration (s) when raising, default 1 — css uses --fx-dur
options.back: Release duration (s), default .7 (ring 1) — in css it is --fx-back
options.look: ring: Round arrow button type — the first wobble is bigger and it bounces back on press
options.look: intro: Plays the wobble that returns right as it opens, like the original (by default it starts after the first touch)

use: Your button here ·
note: The color change (white background → ink) is done by the consuming css with :hover — the part only does the size wobble

from.where: shared.css .nk-btn (pill button) · .nk-arrow (round arrow button, look: ring)
